items.q: Well, you wouldn't have heard him solo with King Oliver, but you would have with Henderson and some of the other small group records that he had put out, or maybe it was some of the blues singers that he had recorded with.

ctx.x: Well, what could I have heard around 1924 or '25?

Well, you wouldn't have heard him solo with King Oliver, but you would have with Henderson and some of the other small group records that he had put out, or maybe it was some of the blues singers that he had recorded with.
